domain_rule: Full rectangular master grid. Geographic domain is the window itself, not a country-list mask. Later terrestrial natural-habitat eligibility is separate.
case_cell_rule: All cells with more than 1 square metre of overlap with the defined case-study polygon; retain overlap fractions and original full-cell geometry.

cases.label: Western Ghats
cases.definition: Union of the four North/South Western Ghats moist deciduous and montane rain-forest ecoregions in RESOLVE 2017. An operational ecological definition, not an administrative boundary.

cases.label: Deccan Plateau dryland subregion
cases.definition: Deccan thorn scrub forests north of 12 N. This predeclared dryland subregion avoids Sri Lankan portions and the southern peninsula and represents the plan's dryland contrast; it is not the entire plateau or proof of present-day savanna land cover.

cases.label: Eastern Himalayan foothill subregion
cases.definition: Himalayan subtropical broadleaf forests east of 88 E, a reproducible Bhutan/eastern foothill segment of the published Siwalik foothill ecoregion. The cutoff is a study decision, not an official eastern-Himalaya boundary; this is not the whole Himalayan range.
